name: change_world
description: Apply one settled world change to match the story. Set `verb` to pick the change and fill that verb's own fields. One call makes one change.

ChangeHindrances.description: Record hindrances the player picks up, sheds, or both at once.

gained.description: Hindrances the actor now carries, that they did not before.

lost.description: Hindrances the actor no longer carries.

actor_id.description: null for the player; else the exact id of a hired party member here who acts.

ChangeHindrances.title: ChangeHindrances

DropItem.description: Take an item out of the player's kit for good.

item_id.description: Exact id of an item the actor carries.

actor_id.description: null for the player; else the exact id of a hired party member here who acts.

DropItem.title: DropItem

Enter.description: Bring a cast member into the current scene.

entity_id.description: Exact id of a cast member not already here.

Enter.title: Enter

GainItem.description: Add an item to the player's kit, spending credits when it costs any.

bulky.description: True when the item takes real space to carry.

breaks.description: How many times the item can break before it is ruined.

cost.description: Credits spent for the item; `cost` 0 only for a thing found or given.

actor_id.description: null for the player; else the exact id of a hired party member here who acts.

GainItem.title: GainItem

JoinParty.description: A character here starts travelling with the player.

entity_id.description: Exact id of who is joining.

JoinParty.title: JoinParty

Kill.description: Record that someone here has died.

entity_id.description: Exact id of who here died.

Kill.title: Kill

Leave.description: Take a cast member out of the current scene.
Leave.title: Leave

LeaveParty.description: A companion stops travelling with the player.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the companion leaving.

LeaveParty.title: LeaveParty

RepairItem.description: Fix a broken item, spending credits when the repair costs any.

item_id.description: Exact id of an item the actor carries, or a ship function.

actor_id.description: null for the player; else the exact id of a hired party member here who acts.

RepairItem.title: RepairItem

Reveal.description: Make a hidden entity known when the player notices, finds, or reaches it.

entity_id.description: Exact id of an entity listed as hidden here.

Reveal.title: Reveal

ShipUpgrade.description: Upgrade one ship function; ₡10 from the player, as the SRD prices it.

function_id.description: Exact id of a ship function; ₡10 from the player.

ShipUpgrade.title: ShipUpgrade

Spend.description: Pay credits for anything that is not an item or a repair: bribes, care, passage.

why.description: What the credits pay for, in a few words.

actor_id.description: null for the player; else the exact id of a hired party member here who acts.

Spend.title: Spend

TakeLead.description: The hired member who leads once the player is dead; answers the succession decision.

entity_id.description: Exact id of the living hired member who takes the lead.

TakeLead.title: TakeLead

change.description: The one world change to apply; `verb` picks the change.

name: next_scene
description: Offer the player the way on: this scene has reached a useful stopping point. They are then asked what they want to pursue, and their own words build the next scene; they may also stay. Do not answer for them. Set `pursuit` instead once the player has left this place. Or set `complication` to bring a new situation down on this place, only when `change_world` (an arrival, a reveal, a death) cannot make it from what is here.

pursuit.description: Set when the player has left this place for good: where they are going, in their own words. Empty to offer the way on from here.

complication.description: Set to change the situation here without the player leaving: what arrives or turns, and why, for the worldsmith. Written now, the turn ends; the player answers it next turn. Empty otherwise.

name: attempt
description: Roll for something whose outcome matters. Name `helped` with why circumstances help, when they do. Name `hindered` with why the actor is hindered, when they are. `helped_by` names a hired crew member who rolls their own die beside the actor's; `actor_id` when a hired member acts instead of the player.

what.description: The attempt, in a few words the player may read; it heads the card.

actor_id.description: null for the player; else the exact id of a hired party member here who acts.

skill.description: Which skill to roll; empty rolls the plain d6.

helped.description: Why circumstances help, when they do.

helped_by.description: A hired crew member who helps: they roll their own die for the skill and the highest counts; `helped` stays the d6 of circumstance.

hindered.description: Why the actor is hindered, when they are.

risking_death.description: True when a disaster kills the actor and a setback maims them; say it before the roll.

name: test_luck
description: Roll a d6 to test the world's bad luck, where nobody is acting.

question.description: A closed question about the world where nobody is acting.

name: defend
description: Break a carried item to turn a hit into a hindrance instead of taking it outright; word the harm yourself.

actor_id.description: null for the player; else the exact id of a hired party member here who acts.

item_id.description: Exact id of an item the actor carries, or a ship function.

hindrance.description: What the harm the actor takes becomes, as a hindrance.

name: find_job
description: The player looks for work: the SRD's d6. Narrate the job the roll allows; `spend` ₡1 is the re-roll; `take_job` when they agree.

where.description: Where, or through whom, the player looks for work, in a few words; it heads the card.

name: take_job
description: The player agrees to work: record the job's terms as agreed. Refused while a job is open.

terms.description: Who wants what done, what done looks like, what it pays, as agreed.

name: finish_job
description: The job is done, by the story and the crew's own words: raise the skill it called on for the player and every living hired member, and pay out its credits; the job then closes.

actor_id.description: null for the player; else the exact id of a hired party member here who acts.

skill.description: The skill the job called on for them, to raise.

raises.description: One per operator: the player and every living hired member, each with the skill the job called on for them.

name: hire
description: The player hires someone here to work: the worldsmith writes their sheet once this turn ends, and they join the party. Someone already travelling with the player may be hired too; a sheet is for someone hired to work, never for one who merely comes along.

entity_id.description: Exact id of who here signs on; they must not already carry a sheet.

terms.description: What they are hired for and on what terms, as agreed, for the worldsmith.
